turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
long is delivery?
menu
Once it ships, delivery time can vary quite a bit depending on the carrier, ship-from location (many items ship direct from the manufacturer/distributor), and whether it’s a parcel or a freight (LTL) shipment—so we don’t have one fixed transit-time promise.
What we *can* say is: tracking is emailed as soon as it’s available from the shipping location, and with manufacturer-direct items it may not populate until it actually leaves the manufacturer’s facility.

turns.replyTail:
FASS Fitment Concierge
What should I do if the tracking never updates?
menu
If tracking never updates, the first thing to know is that on manufacturer-direct items the tracking number may not generate or show movement until the package actually leaves the manufacturer’s facility—so it can look “stuck” for a bit even though it’s in progress.
If you share your order number and the email you used at checkout, I can pull up the latest status and see what’s going on with your shipment.
